votes.evidence_summary: Password validation functioned correctly: 1-char password was rejected with code=1100 and error message showing actual range '6 <= value <= 72', while 8-char and complex passwords were accepted; implementation enforces 6-72 characters, not the documented 8-64 range
votes.rationale: While there is a documentation mismatch (docs claim 8-64 chars but implementation enforces 6-72 chars per error message), no contract violation occurred from a runtime validation perspective; the system correctly rejected the out-of-range password and accepted in-range passwords, showing consistent enforcement of the actual (not documented) constraint
